import json,urllib.request,time,collections
s=json.load(urllib.request.urlopen('http://127.0.0.1:18102/api/claude',timeout=30))
z=[p for p in s['closed']+s['open'] if p['sym']=='ZECUSDT']
z.sort(key=lambda p:p['t_in'])
print('ZEC trades:',len(z))
f=lambda t: time.strftime('%d %H:%M',time.gmtime(t/1000)) if t else '-'
for p in z[-12:]:
    print(p['id'],p['side'],p.get('rule'),'in',f(p['t_in']),'out',f(p.get('t_out')),'entry %.2f stop0 %.2f exit %s'%(p['entry'],p['stop0'],('%.2f'%p['exit']) if p.get('exit') else '-'),p.get('reason'),'R',p.get('r_mult'),'mfe%',round(p.get('mfe_pct') or 0,2))
O=json.load(open('orders.json'))
zo=[o for o in O if o['sym']=='ZEC' and o['placed_t']>=z[-8]['t_in']-7200000] if len(z)>=8 else []
c=collections.Counter((o['rule'],o['status']) for o in zo); print('orders ZEC since',f(z[-8]['t_in']-7200000) if len(z)>=8 else '', dict(c))
canc=collections.Counter(str(o.get('reason'))[:60] for o in zo if o['status']=='cancelled'); print('cancel reasons',dict(canc))
for o in zo[:3]: print({k:o.get(k) for k in ('id','rule','side','price','stop','tp','status','reason','setup')}); print('chan type',(o.get('chan') or {}).get('type'))
EOF
